sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 DealBook 的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、原汁原味的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, just 10 Democratic candidates qualified for the third debate in Houston.
sentences.zh: 今天，只有 10 名民主党候选人获得了在休斯敦举行第三场辩论的资格。

sentences.en: Alex Burns on what a debate looks like when it gets less crowded.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯将带我们探讨当候选人变少时，辩论会是什么样子。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 13 日，星期五。

sentences.en: Okay, so we are going to talk about the debate.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要开始讨论辩论了。

sentences.en: I was actually here for Brexit.
sentences.zh: 我其实是为脱欧来到这里的。

sentences.en: And we're going to do it in a manner that might allow us to be done by midnight.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的方式应该能让我们在午夜前结束。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: That'd be great.
sentences.zh: 那太好了。

sentences.en: And, yeah, that's the plan.
sentences.zh: 没错，这就是计划。

sentences.en: Alex, I wonder if there was a meaningful difference in this third Democratic debate because the field has narrowed so much.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我想知道这场第三场民主党辩论是否有实质性的不同，因为参选人数大大减少了。

sentences.en: I think there's a huge difference that now we're down to a group of people who have really demonstrated that Democratic voters are considering them seriously for the presidency.
sentences.zh: 我认为有巨大的不同，现在我们剩下了一群真正证明了民主党选民正在认真考虑其担任总统资格的人。

sentences.en: In the first couple debates that we had,
sentences.zh: 在我们举办的前几场辩论中，

sentences.en: the stage was so cluttered with people who were essentially these bit players who existed solely to attack other candidates or raise drama or tension of various kinds.
sentences.zh: 舞台上挤满了人，他们基本上都是些龙套角色，其存在纯粹是为了攻击其他候选人，或是制造各种戏剧性和紧张气氛。

sentences.en: You had John Delaney, who seemed like he was solely there to attack Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 你当时有约翰·德拉尼，他看起来完全是为了攻击伊丽莎白·沃伦和伯尼·桑德斯而来的。

sentences.en: You had Eric Swalwell, a congressman from California, whose sole purpose was to taunt Joe Biden about being in his late 70s.
sentences.zh: 你还有埃里克·斯瓦尔韦尔，一名来自加利福尼亚州的国会议员，他唯一的目的就是嘲讽乔·拜登年近八旬。

sentences.en: We didn't have that in this debate, or a lot of it, or a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 我们在这次辩论中没有看到这种情况，或者说没有看到太多。

sentences.en: So take us into the debate, if you would.
sentences.zh: 那么，请带我们了解一下这次辩论吧。

sentences.en: Good evening, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好。

sentences.en: Thank you for this great welcome here at Texas Southern.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家在德克萨斯南方大学给予我们如此热烈的欢迎。

sentences.en: We are so excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: We're so excited for the debate.
sentences.zh: 我们对这场辩论感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I can tell you guys are.
sentences.zh: 我看得出来你们也是。

sentences.en: So you have 10 candidates on stage.
sentences.zh: 舞台上有 10 位候选人。

sentences.en: Former Vice President Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 前副总统乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Joe Biden, the frontrunner, is in the center.
sentences.zh: 领跑者乔·拜登站在正中央。

sentences.en: Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: To his left and right, Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 在他的左右两侧，是伯尼·桑德斯和伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: Former Texas Congressman Beto O'Rourke.
sentences.zh: 前德克萨斯州国会议员贝托·奥Rourke。

sentences.en: Spread out across the rest of the stage, you have the folks who are really fighting for a bigger toehold in this race.
sentences.zh: 散布在舞台其余部分的是那些真正为在这场竞选获得更大立足点而战的人们。

sentences.en: California Senator Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: You have Kamala Harris, Julian Castro, Cory Booker, Amy Klobuchar, Beto O'Rourke, Pete Buttigieg, and Andrew Yang.
sentences.zh: 你有卡玛拉·哈里斯、朱利安·卡斯特罗、科里·布克、埃米·克洛布查尔、贝托·奥鲁克、皮特·布蒂吉格和安德鲁·杨。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, your 10 candidates.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，这就是你们的 10 位候选人。

sentences.en: And what we see over the course of almost three hours, this is a real marathon of a debate.
sentences.zh: 我们在近三个小时的过程中看到的是，这是一场真正的马拉松式辩论。

sentences.en: Was the candidates not just sorting themselves in polarizing binary questions the way we saw earlier in the debate season.
sentences.zh: 候选人们不再像我们在辩论赛季早期看到的那样，只是把自己归入两极分化的二元问题中。

sentences.en: You had them going through really the biggest issues where there is a general democratic consensus on where the country needs to go.
sentences.zh: 你看到他们深入探讨了那些在国家需要走向何方方面有着广泛民主党共识的重大议题。

sentences.en: And then drawing out and refining what their own specific visions are.
sentences.zh: 然后勾勒并完善他们各自的具体愿景。

sentences.en: You didn't hear just straight policy laundry lists the way I think we heard more of earlier in this process.
sentences.zh: 你没有听到那种死板的政策清单，我认为在这个进程的早期我们听得更多。

sentences.en: You heard people talking more in depth about subjects like health care, like guns, like trade, like foreign wars, like race and education.
sentences.zh: 你听到人们更深入地讨论了诸如医疗保健、枪支、贸易、对外战争、种族和教育等主题。

sentences.en: This is big stuff in the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 这些是民主党内部的大事。

sentences.en: And when you are at this phase of the process where they really are looking at a group of people, almost any one of whom they might realistically be able to see as the president,
sentences.zh: 当你处于这个阶段时，他们确实在审视这样一群人，其中几乎任何一个人你都可能现实地看到他成为总统，

sentences.en: they do want to hear answers in something of a more sober and thoughtful tone.
sentences.zh: 他们确实希望听到以更清醒、更深思熟虑的语调做出的回答。

sentences.en: So let's talk about some of the more meaningful moments with that in mind.
sentences.zh: 带着这种想法，让我们来谈谈一些更有意义的时刻。

sentences.en: Well, really, the first big exchange of the night was over health care.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当晚的第一个重大交锋确实是关于医疗保健的。

sentences.en: Out on the campaign trail, you have outlined big differences over how far to go and how fast to go.
sentences.zh: 在竞选活动中，你们对要走多远、走多快阐述了巨大的分歧。

sentences.en: Joe Biden right out of the gate.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登一开场就直奔主题。

sentences.en: Are senators Warren and Sanders pushing too far beyond where Democrats want to go and where the country needs to go?
sentences.zh: 沃伦参议员和桑德斯参议员的推动是否超出了民主党人乃至国家需要的范畴？

sentences.en: That'll be for the voters to decide that question.
sentences.zh: 这个问题将由选民来决定。

sentences.en: Let me tell you what I think.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你们我的想法。

sentences.en: He's asked about the policies of Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders, and he delivers this obviously prepared line,
sentences.zh: 当被问及伊丽莎白·沃伦和伯尼·桑德斯的政策时，他发表了这番显然经过准备的言论，

sentences.en: alluding to the way Warren talks about her support for single payer.
sentences.zh: 暗指沃伦谈论她对单一支付医疗体系的支持方式。

sentences.en: I know that the senator says she's for Bernie.
sentences.zh: 我知道这位参议员说她支持伯尼。

sentences.en: Well, I'm for Barack.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我支持巴拉克。

sentences.en: I think the Obamacare worked.
sentences.zh: 我认为奥巴马医改奏效了。

sentences.en: He questions the practicality of single payer, demands to know how they would pay for it.
sentences.zh: 他对单一支付体系的实用性提出质疑，要求知道他们将如何为此买单。

sentences.en: I think we should be in a position of taking a look at what costs are.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该处于审视成本是什么的位置。

sentences.en: What you see on the more progressive side of that exchange is his challengers not giving an inch.
sentences.zh: 在这次交锋中，在更倾向进步主义的一侧，你看到他的挑战者们毫不退让。

sentences.en: So let's be clear about health care, and let's actually start where Vice President did.
sentences.zh: 因此，让我们明确医疗保健问题，实际上让我们从副总统提到的地方开始。

sentences.en: We all owe a huge debt to President Obama.
sentences.zh: 我们都欠奥巴马总统巨大的人情。

sentences.en: You see Warren pivot, I think, very fluidly from saying we all owe a huge debt to Barack Obama, but now we need to go beyond that.
sentences.zh: 你看到沃伦巧妙地转换了话题，我认为她非常流畅地从“我们都欠巴拉克·奥巴马巨大的人情”转到了“但现在我们需要超越这一点”。

sentences.en: And I believe the best way we can do that is we make sure that everybody gets covered by health care at the lowest possible coSt.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们能做到这一点的最好方法是，我们确保每个人都能以尽可能低的成本获得医疗保障。

sentences.en: You see this pretty tense exchange between Biden and Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 你看到拜登和伯尼·桑德斯之间有着相当紧张的交锋。

sentences.en: In the United States of America, we are spending twice as much per capita on health care.
sentences.zh: 在美利坚合众国，我们在医疗保健上的人均支出是两倍。

sentences.en: Talks about how the Canadians pay so much less for health care than we do, and Biden shoots back in this, I think, very sort of politically traditional way.
sentences.zh: 他谈到加拿大人在医疗保健上的花费比我们少得多，而拜登以一种我认为非常具有政治传统的方式进行了回击。

sentences.en: This is America.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国。

sentences.en: This is America.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国。

sentences.en: And Sanders does not give an inch.
sentences.zh: 而桑德斯毫不退让。

sentences.en: Yeah, but Americans don't want to pay twice as much as other countries, and they guarantee health care to all people.
sentences.zh: 是的，但美国人不想支付其他国家两倍的费用，而其他国家为所有人提供了医疗保障。

sentences.en: When you don't pay out of pocket and you don't pay premiums, maybe you have run into people who love their premiuMs.
sentences.zh: 当你不用自己掏钱，也不用支付保费时，也许你遇到过热爱自己保费的人。

sentences.en: I haven't.
sentences.zh: 我没有遇到过。

sentences.en: It's been a while since you have had Democratic candidates so openly debating two such drastically different views of the health care system.
sentences.zh: 民主党候选人如此公开地辩论医疗保健系统的两种截然不同的观点，已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: It wasn't personal.
sentences.zh: 这不是针对个人的。

sentences.en: It wasn't the kind of theatrical exchange that we saw at a couple moments in the first two rounds of debates.
sentences.zh: 这不像我们在前两轮辩论中某些时刻看到的那种戏剧性交锋。

sentences.en: But it did really get to the heart of what is the question hangover the Biden candidacy, which is,
sentences.zh: 但它确实触及了萦绕在拜登参选之上的核心问题，那就是，

sentences.en: do voters want a path back to something that they feel is a happy kind of normalcy?
sentences.zh: 选民是否想要一条通往他们认为的快乐常态的道路？

sentences.en: Do Democrats want to turn back the clock to the Obama administration, which they really liked,
sentences.zh: 民主党人是想把时钟拨回他们非常喜欢的奥巴马政府时期，

sentences.en: or do they feel like that was all well and good and now we need to go a good deal further than that?
sentences.zh: 还是觉得那一切都很好，现在我们需要走得更远？

sentences.en: We're not going to know for a while who actually has the better end of that argument,
sentences.zh: 我们短时间内还不会知道谁的论点更有说服力，

sentences.en: but it was a stark and civil and sophisticated display of the differences on the issue that polls still show is the most important one to voters.
sentences.zh: 但这展现了对该议题分歧的鲜明、文明且老练的阐述，民调仍然显示这是选民最关心的议题。

sentences.en: What can you say after this exchange about which plan from these three candidates costs more?
sentences.zh: 这场交锋之后，关于这三位候选人的计划哪个成本更高，你能说些什么？

sentences.en: Because all three of them are sort of convincingly arguing that the other one has it all wrong, your logic, your math, it's not right, mine is.
sentences.zh: 因为这三个人都在以颇具说服力的方式争辩说对方完全搞错了，你的逻辑、你的算术不对，我的才是对的。

sentences.en: What's happening here is they are talking about cost in entirely different ways.
sentences.zh: 这里发生的情况是，他们以完全不同的方式在讨论成本。

sentences.en: Nobody's yet said how much it's going to cost the taxpayer.
sentences.zh: 还没有人说这会给纳税人带来多少成本。

sentences.en: I hear this, large savings.
sentences.zh: 我听到的是巨大的节省。

sentences.en: Joe Biden thinks that telling people that their taxes went up, but they're no longer paying premiums to private health care companies, and so you're actually saving money,
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登认为，告诉人们他们的税收上升了，但他们不再向私人医疗保健公司支付保费，因此实际上是在省钱，

sentences.en: is not a good bet politically.
sentences.zh: 这在政治上并不是一笔划算的买卖。

sentences.en: That Americans don't like taxes,
sentences.zh: 美国人不喜欢税收，

sentences.en: that to tell people who are making $30,000 or $70,000 a year your taxes are going to go up to pay for your single-payer health care doesn't compute as a political proposition.
sentences.zh: 告诉年收入 3 万或 7 万美元的人，你们的税收将会增加以支付单一支付医疗保健费用，从政治角度来看是讲不通的。

sentences.en: Under my legislation, people will not go into financial ruin because they suffered with a diagnosis of cancer.
sentences.zh: 在我的立法下，人们不会因为患上癌症诊断而陷入财务废墟。

sentences.en: The Bernie Sanders perspective is, and this is a perspective that Elizabeth Warren spelled out as well,
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯的观点是——这也是伊丽莎白·沃伦阐述过的观点——

sentences.en: is that what Americans care about is how much money is in their bank account at the end of the month,
sentences.zh: 美国人关心的是月底他们的银行账户里有多少钱，

sentences.en: and it's just a question of whether they're paying it as taxes to the government or whether they're paying it as checks to an insurance company.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个问题，究竟是作为税收支付给政府，还是作为支票支付给保险公司。

sentences.en: Is it possible that they're both right, since they're doing kind of apples and oranges mathematics here?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能他们两个都是对的，因为他们在这里做的某种程度上是苹果和橘子的数学比较？

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，有可能。

sentences.en: What's not possible is that they're both right that the other person's plan is totally toxic and radioactive and that their own plan is the obvious way forward.
sentences.zh: 不可能的是，他们双方都认为对方的计划完全是有毒的、放射性的，而他们自己的计划才是显而易见的康庄大道，他们都对。

sentences.en: They can't both be right about that, but they are essentially sizing up more or less fairly the vulnerabilities on each side.
sentences.zh: 他们不可能在这点上都对，但他们基本上或多或少公平地评估了各自阵营的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Okay, let's move on to the next moment that you think stood out.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们继续谈谈你认为脱颖而出的下一个时刻。

sentences.en: What was that for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说那是哪个时刻？

sentences.en: I want to turn to the deadly mass shootings here in this country.
sentences.zh: 我想转向这个国家的致命大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: You have this really vivid, detailed exchange between Beto O'Rourke and Cory Booker over gun control.
sentences.zh: 贝托·奥鲁克和科里·布克就枪支管控展开了非常生动、详细的交锋。

sentences.en: On August 3rd in El Paso, Texas, two things became crystal clear for me and I think produced a turning point for this country.
sentences.zh: 8 月 3 日在得克萨斯州埃尔帕索，有两件事对我来说变得极其清晰，我认为这也为这个国家创造了一个转折点。

sentences.en: You have O'Rourke, who has really taken on a different kind of persona as a candidate since the mass shooting in El Paso last month,
sentences.zh: 奥鲁克自上个月埃尔帕索大规模枪击事件以来，作为一名候选人采取了截然不同的形象，

sentences.en: talking about the scourge of gun violence needing to go much further than most other Democrats have recommended.
sentences.zh: 他谈到枪支暴力的祸害需要比大多数其他民主党人建议的走得更远。

sentences.en: When we see that being used against children, hell yes, we're going to take your AR-15, your AK-47.
sentences.zh: 当我们看到这些被用来对付儿童时，见鬼，是的，我们要收缴你的 AR-15、你的 AK-47。

sentences.en: Requiring Americans who own assault-style rifles to give them up, to sell them back to the government.
sentences.zh: 要求拥有突击步枪的美国人交出这些枪支，将其回售给政府。

sentences.en: Look, I grew up in the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 听着，我在郊区长大。

sentences.en: It was about 20 years ago that I came out of my home when I moved to inner city Newark, New Jersey, and witnessed the aftermath of a shooting.
sentences.zh: 大约 20 年前，当我搬到新泽西州纽瓦克市内城，走出家门并目睹了一场枪击事件的后果时。

sentences.en: You then hear Cory Booker not exactly criticizing or pushing back on Beto O'Rourke, but explaining that he's taking a different path.
sentences.zh: 然后你听到科里·布克并没有确切地批评或反驳贝托·奥鲁克，而是解释说他正在走一条不同的道路。

sentences.en: For me, it's why I was the first person to come out for gun licensing.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是为什么我是第一个支持枪支许可的人。

sentences.en: A federal gun registry, and then sort of gently pushing back on the moral authority that O'Rourke really claimed for himself on the issue.
sentences.zh: 联邦枪支登记系统，然后某种程度上温和地反驳了奥鲁克在枪支议题上真正声称的道德权威。

sentences.en: And I'm happy that people like Beto O'Rourke are showing such courage now, but this is what I'm sorry about.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴像贝托·奥鲁克这样的人现在表现出这样的勇气，但这就是我感到遗憾的地方。

sentences.en: I'm sorry that it had to take issues coming to my neighborhood or personally affecting Beto to suddenly make us demand change.
sentences.zh: 我遗憾的是，必须要等到问题来到我的社区，或者亲自影响到贝托，才突然让我们要求改变。

sentences.en: You've not seen quite such a robust Democratic debate about what to do on gun control in quite some time.
sentences.zh: 你已经很久没有看到关于如何处理枪支管控的如此强健的民主党辩论了。

sentences.en: That you, not that long ago, had a real sense across the party that it was an issue where you had to proceed with caution.
sentences.zh: 就在不久前，党内还普遍有一种感觉，这是一个你必须谨慎行事的议题。

sentences.en: You don't hear a lot of folks on that stage saying, we should just tighten up the loopholes and background checks and call it a day.
sentences.zh: 你听不到台上的很多人说，我们应该收紧漏洞和背景调查，然后就此收工。

sentences.en: You don't have too many voices saying, not so faSt.
sentences.zh: 没有太多声音说，别那么快。

sentences.en: Right, and there wasn't the typical refrain from candidates defending safe gun owners, hunters, you know, friends, neighbors, family members who use it responsibly.
sentences.zh: 没错，候选人也没有发出典型的副歌，去捍卫安全的枪支拥有者、猎人、你知道的，那些负责任地使用枪支的朋友、邻居、家庭成员。

sentences.en: No, there's not this sense that Democrats need to engage in this kind of cultural signaling to the middle of the country that,
sentences.zh: 不，并没有这种感觉，即民主党人需要向美国中部进行这种文化信号传递，

sentences.en: you know, I may want background checks, but I respect your right to own guns X, Y, and Z.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可能想要背景调查，但我尊重你拥有枪支的权利 X、Y 和 Z。

sentences.en: Everyone up here favors magazine limitations, which by the way...
sentences.zh: 台上的每个人都赞成弹匣限制，顺便说一句……

sentences.en: Even Amy Klobuchar, who in so many ways was this voice of Midwestern moderation on stage, was much more gentle in this particular moment that she said, you know,
sentences.zh: 甚至埃米·克洛布查尔，她在很多方面都是舞台上中西部温和派的声音，在这个特定的时刻表现得温和得多，她说，你知道的，

sentences.en: let's focus on the things that unite Democrats, not these issues where there may be less consensus in the party.
sentences.zh: 让我们关注那些团结民主党人的事情，而不是那些党内共识可能较少的议题。

sentences.en: Talking about, you know, voluntary buybacks, talking about background checks, stuff that's already been put to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 谈到，你知道的，自愿回购，谈到背景调查，这些已经提交给参议院的东西。

sentences.en: So what's the next moment for you?
sentences.zh: 那么对你来说下一个时刻是什么？

sentences.en: I want to turn now to our troops overseas into America's longest war in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 我现在想转向我们在海外的部队和美国最长的战争——阿富汗战争。

sentences.en: You have this pair of exchanges over the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan that really get a little bit more deeply into foreign policy than we've seen so far in this race.
sentences.zh: 关于伊拉克和阿富汗战争，你有一对交锋，它们比我们在这场竞选中迄今为止看到的更深入地触及了外交政策。

sentences.en: You have the moderators ask several of the candidates alluding to President Trump's talks with the Taliban, whether they think it's time to get out of Afghanistan,
sentences.zh: 主持人要求几位候选人谈谈特朗普总统与塔利班的会谈，他们是否认为现在是撤出阿富汗的时候了，

sentences.en: whether they would leave even without a peace deal with the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 他们是否会在没有与塔利班达成和平协议的情况下离开。

sentences.en: Would you keep that promise to bring the troops home starting right now with no deal with the Taliban?
sentences.zh: 你们会信守承诺，从现在开始把部队带回家，而与塔利班没有任何协议吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren says yes.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦说是。

sentences.en: She says time to come home.
sentences.zh: 她说现在是回家的时候了。

sentences.en: And I think more than most voters would have heard her on other questions, really gets into her personal connection to the issue,
sentences.zh: 我认为，比选民在其他问题上听到她的情况更多的是，这真正深入到了她与该议题的个人联系，

sentences.en: talking about her brothers having served in the military and having a sense of what a war does to people as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 谈到她的兄弟曾在军队服役，因此对战争对人造成的后果有了一种切身感受。

sentences.en: They will do anything we ask them to do, but we cannot ask them to solve problems that they alone cannot solve.
sentences.zh: 他们会做任何我们要求他们去做的事，但我们不能要求他们去解决他们独自无法解决的问题。

sentences.en: It is a really stark difference between her and a couple of the other leading candidates in the race that she says bring the troops home now.
sentences.zh: 这与竞选中的其他几位领先候选人形成了鲜明的对比，她表示现在就把部队带回家。

sentences.en: You know, I served under General Dunford, way under General Dunford in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我曾在邓福德将军手下服役，在阿富汗远远地在邓福德将军手下服役。

sentences.en: Pete Buttigieg comes in with a personal story of his own, in some ways a much more immediate personal story about having served in Afghanistan himself.
sentences.zh: 皮特·布蒂吉格带着他自己的个人故事登场了，在某种程度上这是一个更加直接的个人故事，关于他自己曾在阿富汗服役。

sentences.en: And today, September 12th, 2019, means that today you could be 18 years old, old enough to serve, and have not been alive on 9-11.
sentences.zh: 而在今天，2019年9月12日，这意味着今天你可能18岁，到了服役的年龄，但在9-11时你甚至还没出生。

sentences.en: He too says it's time to come home.
sentences.zh: 他也说现在是回家的时候了。

sentences.en: He doesn't say let's bring the troops home tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他没有说让我们明天就把军队接回家。

sentences.en: We have got to put an end to endless war.
sentences.zh: 我们必须彻底终结无休止的战争。

sentences.en: He uses this phrase, endless war.
sentences.zh: 他用了这个词，无休止的战争。

sentences.en: You've heard other candidates talk about ending forever wars.
sentences.zh: 你们听过其他候选人谈论结束永恒的战争。

sentences.en: This has become a much clearer consensus in the Democratic Party than it was even four years ago,
sentences.zh: 在民主党内部，这已经形成了比四年前清晰得多的共识，

sentences.en: when I think you would have heard a much more reserved Hillary Clinton talking about under what conditions and when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时我想你会听到希拉里·克林顿以更加保守的姿态谈论在什么条件下以及何时美国

sentences.en: ought to get out of Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 应该撤出阿富汗。

sentences.en: In some respects, it's probably a statement on where President Trump has moved on this issue, that these aren't candidates who are preparing to run a general election,
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这可能反映了特朗普总统在这个问题上的立场变化，这些候选人并不准备在进行大选时，

sentences.en: worry that the Republican is going to trash them for wanting to get out of Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 担心共和党会因为他们想要撤出阿富汗而对他们进行抨击。

sentences.en: President Trump himself wants to get out of Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统本人就想撤出阿富汗。

sentences.en: I think there used to be, not that different from what we were just talking about on guns,
sentences.zh: 我认为过去的情况——这与我们刚才谈论的枪支问题没有太大不同——

sentences.en: the sense among Democrats that you really had to worry about going into a general election not being perceived as a hawk,
sentences.zh: 在于民主党人有一种观念，即你真的必须担心在进入大选时被认为不够强硬，

sentences.en: not being perceived as somebody who was going to be pretty willing to use military force.
sentences.zh: 被认为不是一个相当乐意使用军事力量的人。

sentences.en: And it does seem, at least right now, like there's a sense from most of the candidates on stage that that's not such a great concern,
sentences.zh: 而现在看来，至少目前，台上的大多数候选人都觉得这并不是什么大问题，

sentences.en: that the American people are tired of these wars.
sentences.zh: 美国人民已经厌倦了这些战争。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程式？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程式时，在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用程式，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So a final moment, Alex.
sentences.zh: 那么最后留点时间，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: I'll give you one more.
sentences.zh: 我再给你一个问题。

sentences.en: I think we have to talk about Julian Castro and Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须谈谈朱利安·卡斯特罗和乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Look, I agree that Barack Obama was very different from Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 听着，我承认巴拉克·奥巴马与唐纳德·特朗普截然不同。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has a dark heart when it comes to immigrants.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在对待移民问题时内心黑暗。

sentences.en: There is friction between the two, almost the entire debate, building to this moment where they clash over immigration policy, where Biden is challenged by one of the moderators
sentences.zh: 两人之间存在摩擦，几乎贯穿了整场辩论，并最终酝酿到了这一刻：他们就移民政策发生冲突，拜登遭到其中一位主持人的质问，

sentences.en: on the Obama administration's record of deporting millions of illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 质问奥巴马政府驱逐数百万非法移民的记录。

sentences.en: And Castro comes at him.
sentences.zh: 而卡斯特罗向他发难。

sentences.en: But my problem with Vice President Biden, and Corey pointed this out last time, is every time something good about Barack Obama comes up,
sentences.zh: 但我对拜登副总统的问题在于——科里上次也指出了这一点——每当提到巴拉克·奥巴马的好事时，

sentences.en: he says, oh, I was there, I was there, I was there.
sentences.zh: 他就会说，哦，我在场，我在场，我在场。

sentences.en: That's me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是其中一份子。

sentences.en: And then every time somebody questions part of the administration that we were both part of, he says, well, that was the president.
sentences.zh: 然后每当有人质疑我们两个人都曾身处其中的政府的某一部分时，他就会说，嗯，那是总统决定的。

sentences.en: I mean, he wants to take credit for Obama's work, but not have to answer any questions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他想将奥巴马的政绩归功于自己，却又不想回答任何问题。

sentences.en: Accusing him of trying to use Obama as this convenient prop and underpinning all of this is the division, the debate within the party about just how liberal
sentences.zh: 指责他试图将奥巴马当作一个顺手的道具，而这一切的底层逻辑是党内关于究竟应该在移民问题上表现得多么自由派的分歧和辩论，

sentences.en: they ought to be on immigration, that Julian Castro has called for decriminalizing border crossing, really changing the whole legal framework around immigration,
sentences.zh: 即朱利安·卡斯特罗呼吁将越境行为非刑事化，真正改变围绕移民的整个法律框架，

sentences.en: not just pulling back the abuses of the Trump administration, but going much, much further in redrawing how American immigration works.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是收回特朗普政府的滥权行为，更要在重塑美国移民运作方式上走得更远、更彻底。

sentences.en: We have heard Joe Biden in previous debates talk about how a crime is a crime and we're going to enforce the border and that's how it works.
sentences.zh: 我们听过乔·拜登在先前的辩论中谈到犯罪就是犯罪，我们要守住边境，事情就是这样的。

sentences.en: Are you prepared to say tonight that you and President Obama made a mistake about deportations?
sentences.zh: 你今晚准备好承认你和奥巴马总统在驱逐出境问题上犯了错误吗？

sentences.en: Why should Latinos trust you?
sentences.zh: 为什么拉丁裔应该信任你？

sentences.en: This is the president who sent a legislation to the desk saying he wants to find a pathway for the 11 million undocumented in the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这位总统曾向国会提交立法，表示他希望为美国境内的1100万无证移民寻找一条合法途径。

sentences.en: We did not hear him go quite as far tonight, but Biden is still clearly uncomfortable defending all of the substance of the Obama administration's record on this front.
sentences.zh: 我们今晚没有听到他走得那么远，但拜登在为奥巴马政府在这方面的全部实质记录进行辩护时，显然仍然感到不自在。

sentences.en: This is the president who's done a great deal, so I'm proud to have served with him.
sentences.zh: 这位总统做了大量工作，所以我很自豪能与他共事。

sentences.en: What I would do as president is several more things.
sentences.zh: 如果我当选总统，我会做更多的事情。

sentences.en: He pivots away from it.
sentences.zh: 他转移了话题。

sentences.en: He talks about how, well, we didn't put kids in cages like the Trump administration, although the actual story there is somewhat more complicated.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了我们没有像特朗普政府那样把儿童关在笼子里，尽管那里的实际情况要复杂一些。

sentences.en: Yeah, but you didn't answer the question.
sentences.zh: 是的，但你没有回答问题。

sentences.en: Did you make a mistake with those deportations?
sentences.zh: 你们在那些驱逐行动上犯了错误吗？

sentences.en: The president did the best thing that was able to be done at the time.
sentences.zh: 总统做了当时能够做到的最好的事情。

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm the vice president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我是美利坚合众国副总统。

sentences.en: He doesn't say those deportations were the right thing to do and I would do them again.
sentences.zh: 他没有说那些驱逐行动是正确的事，如果重来一次他还会这么做。

sentences.en: This is another reflection of how the party has clearly moved to the left, how there is this sense across the Democratic coalition and clearly even in this case
sentences.zh: 这再次反映了该党明显向左转的趋势，反映出整个民主党阵营以及显然甚至在此案中，

sentences.en: recognized by Joe Biden that just switching back to the policies of the Democratic Party circa 2016 is not going to be satisfying to most of the party's voters.
sentences.zh: 连乔·拜登也认识到，仅仅倒退回2016年前后的民主党政策是无法让该党大多数选民满意的。

sentences.en: As we're talking, it occurs to me that none of the expected and kind of familiar dynamics
sentences.zh: 在我们交谈时，我突然想到，那些预料之中且有些熟悉的动态

sentences.en: really played out tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚并没有真正上演。

sentences.en: It wasn't a night where the top three candidates went after each other,
sentences.zh: 今晚并不是前三名候选人互相攻击的夜晚，

sentences.en: Biden after Warren,
sentences.zh: 拜登攻击沃伦，

sentences.en: Sanders after Warren or Biden.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯攻击沃伦或拜登。

sentences.en: It just, that wasn't the feel of the night.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是今晚的基调。

sentences.en: It felt much more like a fulsome debate between basically all 10 candidates.
sentences.zh: 感觉更像是一场基本上在所有10名候选人之间展开的充分辩论。

sentences.en: I think it was the kind of debate that people claim they want to see in politics.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一场人们声称希望在政治中看到的辩论。

sentences.en: It was really focused on policy.
sentences.zh: 它真正聚焦于政策。

sentences.en: It was fluid.
sentences.zh: 它是流畅的。

sentences.en: It was complicated.
sentences.zh: 它是复杂的。

sentences.en: So in that respect, I think it was a pretty impressive debate.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，我认为这是一场相当令人印象深刻的辩论。

sentences.en: I'm not sure that it was the kind of debate that we're going to look back on as any kind of turning point in this race.
sentences.zh: 我不确定我们会不会把这场辩论看作是本次竞选中的某种转折点。

sentences.en: We didn't see the clash that we were expecting between Joe Biden and Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到我们所期望的乔·拜登和伊丽莎白·沃伦之间的交锋。

sentences.en: They definitely detailed some of their differences, but you didn't see either one of them trying to take out the other one.
sentences.zh: 他们确实详细阐述了一些分歧，但你没有看到他们任何一个人试图击垮对方。

sentences.en: There was no moment in this debate of the kind that we saw back in June between Kamala Harris and Joe Biden where it just felt like, oh my goodness, this is a different race now.
sentences.zh: 今晚的辩论中没有出现我们在6月份卡玛拉·哈里斯和乔·拜登之间看到的那种时刻，当时只觉得，天哪，现在的选战完全不同了。

sentences.en: Senator Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's great to be back at TSU.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回到德克萨斯南方大学（TSU）。

sentences.en: In fact, Kamala Harris did not go after Joe Biden almost at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，卡玛拉·哈里斯几乎根本没有攻击乔·拜登。

sentences.en: But first, I have a few words for Donald Trump, who we all know is watching.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我对唐纳德·特朗普说几句话，我们都知道他在收看节目。

sentences.en: So President Trump...
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普总统……

sentences.en: She focused from her opening statement to the end of the debate as much as she could on President Trump.
sentences.zh: 从开场白到辩论结束，她尽可能地将焦点集中在特朗普总统身上。

sentences.en: And I plan on focusing on our common issues, our common hopes and desires, and in that way, unifying our country, winning this election, and turning the page for America.
sentences.zh: 我计划将重点放在我们共同的议题、共同的期望与愿望上，以此团结我们的国家，赢得这次选举，并为美国翻开新的一页。

sentences.en: And now, President Trump, you can go back to watching Fox News.
sentences.zh: 现在，特朗普总统，你可以回去看福克斯新闻了。

sentences.en: Pretty clearly a shift in strategy there, away from trying to be somebody who voters will appreciate for beating up on the frontrunner to somebody who is more explicitly
sentences.zh: 这显然是策略上的转变，不再试图成为一个因痛击领跑者而受到选民赞赏的人，而是更明确地把自己定位为

sentences.en: pitching themselves as a general election candidate, as a unifying character.
sentences.zh: 大选候选人，一个具有凝聚力的角色。

sentences.en: And Biden himself, I don't know that we are going to look back on this debate as one that particularly changed the trajectory of his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 而拜登本人，我不知道我们是否会回过头来把这场辩论视为特别改变了他竞选轨迹的一场辩论。

sentences.en: He did not have a terrible moment like he did with Harris in that first debate, but he was also a far from dominant figure.
sentences.zh: 他没有像在第一场辩论对阵哈里斯时那样遭遇可怕的时刻，但他远非一个占据主导地位的人物。

sentences.en: Make sure that we bring in the help of the teachers deal with the problems that come from home.
sentences.zh: 确保我们引入教师的帮助来解决来自家庭的问题。

sentences.en: You did not have some big moment, big powerful moment of Joe Biden laying out his vision for the country in a way that would probably make people say,
sentences.zh: 你没有看到乔·拜登那种宏大有力、阐述他对国家愿景的时刻，那种可能会让人说出以下话语的时刻：

sentences.en: you know, my doubts about him are gone.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我对他的疑虑已经烟消云散了。

sentences.en: There were moments when he was clear and crisp and forceful.
sentences.zh: 有时他的表达清晰、干练且有力。

sentences.en: They don't know quite what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们简直不知所措。

sentences.en: Play the radio.
sentences.zh: 播放收音机。

sentences.en: Make sure the television, excuse me.
sentences.zh: 确保电视，抱歉。

sentences.en: And there were more moments where he was, you know, kind of meandering and interrupting himself and shifting his focus mid-answer.
sentences.zh: 但更多的时刻是，你知道的，他有些语无伦次、不断打断自己，并在回答问题中途转移焦点。

sentences.en: Make sure you have the record player on at night.
sentences.zh: 确保你晚上开着留声机。

sentences.en: The phone, make sure the kids hear words.
sentences.zh: 电话，确保孩子们听到声音。

sentences.en: We're just not at the stage of this race where you are going to have, it seems, the two or three or four top candidates trying to knock each other totally out of the race
sentences.zh: 我们目前的选战阶段似乎还没有到达那种两三名或四名顶尖候选人试图在那个舞台上

sentences.en: on that stage.
sentences.zh: 将彼此彻底淘汰出局的地步。

sentences.en: Many of these campaigns still see themselves in the stage of introducing themselves to the public, that there are people like a Cory Booker or Julian Castro and Amy Klobuchar
sentences.zh: 其中许多竞选团队仍然认为自己处于向公众进行自我介绍的阶段，像科里·布克、朱利安·卡斯特罗和埃米·克洛布查尔这样的人

sentences.en: who may still be making a first impression on many people.
sentences.zh: 可能仍在给许多人留下第一印象。

sentences.en: There are other candidates, somebody like an Elizabeth Warren or Kamala Harris, to some extent Pete Buttigieg, who have made a first impression,
sentences.zh: 还有其他候选人，比如伊丽莎白·沃伦或卡玛拉·哈里斯，在某种程度上还有皮特·布蒂吉格，他们已经留下了第一印象，

sentences.en: but now they're trying to show people
sentences.zh: 但现在他们正试图向人们展示

sentences.en: I'm not just an interesting or likable character.
sentences.zh: 我不只是一个有趣或讨人喜欢的角色。

sentences.en: I'm somebody who you can and should see as your next president.
sentences.zh: 我是你可以而且应该视作下一任总统的人。

sentences.en: And until those candidates feel like they have sufficiently introduced themselves on their own terms, I think you're going to see real reluctance by a lot of them
sentences.zh: 在这些候选人觉得他们已经按照自己的方式充分自我介绍之前，我认为你会看到他们中的许多人

sentences.en: to define themselves in terms of a conflict with somebody else.
sentences.zh: 真正不愿意通过与他人的冲突来定义自己。

sentences.en: I've known what I wanted to be since second grade.
sentences.zh: 我从二年级起就知道自己想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: I wanted to be a public school teacher and I made it as a special needs teacher.
sentences.zh: 我想成为一名公立学校教师，我如愿成为了一名特殊需求教师。

sentences.en: But at the end of that first year, I was visibly pregnant.
sentences.zh: 但在那第一年结束时，我已明显显怀。

sentences.en: And back in the day, that meant that the principal wished me luck and hired someone else for the job.
sentences.zh: 而在过去，这意味着校长祝我好运，并为这份工作雇用了别人。

sentences.en: So there I am.
sentences.zh: 所以我就这样了。

sentences.en: What am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 我要怎么办？

sentences.en: I said, I'll go to law school.
sentences.zh: 我说，我要去读法学院。

sentences.en: And I, with a bunch of tenant leaders in Newark, New Jersey in 2002, took on the political machine and boy, did they fight back.
sentences.zh: 2002年，我与新泽西州纽瓦克的许多租户领袖一起，向政治机器发起挑战，天哪，他们进行了猛烈反击。

sentences.en: And we lost that election.
sentences.zh: 我们输掉了那场选举。

sentences.en: And here's a bit of advice to everybody.
sentences.zh: 这里给所有人一点建议。

sentences.en: If you're going to have a spectacular failure, have a documentary team there to capture it because it made for an Oscar-nominated documentary called Street Fight.
sentences.zh: 如果你要遭遇一场惨败，找一个纪录片团队来记录它，因为它催生了一部获得奥斯卡提名的纪录片叫《街头战》（Street Fight）。

sentences.en: But then, unfortunately, another setback, it lost in the Oscars to a movie called
sentences.zh: 但随后不幸的是，又遭遇了一次挫折，它在奥斯卡奖中输给了一部名为

sentences.en: March of the Dagnab Penguins for crying out loud.
sentences.zh: 《帝企鹅日记》（March of the Dagnab Penguins）的电影，真是活见鬼。

sentences.en: I grew up in a single-parent household on the west side of San Antonio.
sentences.zh: 我在圣安东尼奥西区的一个单亲家庭长大。

sentences.en: Going to the public schools.
sentences.zh: 就读于公立学校。

sentences.en: Eventually, my brother
sentences.zh: 最终，我和我的兄弟

sentences.en: Joaquin and I became the first in our family to become professionals.
sentences.zh: 华金成为了我们家族中第一代专业人士。

sentences.en: My father grew up on a peanut farm in Asia with no floor.
sentences.zh: 我父亲在亚洲的一个没有地板的花生农场长大。

sentences.en: And now his son is running for president.
sentences.zh: 现在他的儿子正在竞选总统。

sentences.en: That is the immigration story that we have to be able to share with the American people.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们必须能够与美国人民分享的移民故事。

sentences.en: And our daughter was born.
sentences.zh: 然后我们的女儿出生了。

sentences.en: I had this expectation.
sentences.zh: 我当时满怀期待。

sentences.en: We're going to have this perfect, perfect birth.
sentences.zh: 我们将会有一个完美、完美的生育过程。

sentences.en: And she was really sick.
sentences.zh: 但她病得很重。

sentences.en: When she was born, they had a rule in place that you got kicked out of the hospital in 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 她出生时，医院有一条规定，即24小时内必须离开医院。

sentences.en: She was in intensive care and I was kicked out.
sentences.zh: 她在重症监护室，而我被赶了出来。

sentences.en: And I thought, this could never happen to any other mom again.
sentences.zh: 我想，绝不能再让其他任何母亲经历这种事。

sentences.en: That is what motivated me to go into public service.
sentences.zh: 这就是激励我投身公共服务的动力。

sentences.en: You know, as a military officer serving under
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为一名曾在

sentences.en: Don't Ask, Don't Tell and as an elected official in the state of Indiana when Mike Pence was governor,
sentences.zh: “不问，不说”政策下服役的军官，以及迈克·彭斯担任州长时印第安纳州的民选官员，

sentences.en: at a certain point when it came to professional setbacks,
sentences.zh: 在职业挫折的特定节点上，

sentences.en: I had to wonder whether just acknowledging who I was was going to be the ultimate career-ending professional setback.
sentences.zh: 我不得不怀疑，仅仅承认真实的自我是否会成为最终断送职业生涯的挫折。

sentences.en: I came back from the deployment and realized that you only get to live one life and I was not interested
sentences.zh: 我结束部署归来，意识到人只能活一次，而我再也不想

sentences.en: in not knowing what it was like to be in love any longer.
sentences.zh: 不知道陷入爱河是什么滋味了。

sentences.en: So I just came out.
sentences.zh: 所以我选择出柜。

sentences.en: I had no idea what kind of professional setback it would be, especially because inconveniently, it was an election year in my socially conservative community.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道这会带来什么样的职业挫折，尤其是很不巧的是，在我这个保守的选区里，当年正好是选举年。

sentences.en: What happened was that when I trusted voters to judge me based on the job that I did for them, they decided to trust me and re-elected me with 80% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 结果是，当我信任选民，让他们根据我为他们所做的工作来评判我时，他们选择信任我，并以80%的得票率让我连任。

sentences.en: And you do wonder watching an event like that, what voters will take away, whether it will be the policy differences, whether it will be those powerful personal stories,
sentences.zh: 当你观看这样一场活动时，你确实会想，选民会从中有何收获，是政策分歧，还是那些强有力的个人故事，

sentences.en: and how they will react when inevitably the race actually does get much nastier.
sentences.zh: 以及当竞选不可避免地变得更加恶劣时他们会作何反应。

sentences.en: This moment won't last forever.
sentences.zh: 这一刻不会永远持续下去。

sentences.en: Thank you, Alex.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The resolution before us represents the necessary next step in our investigation of corruption, obstruction, and abuse of power.
sentences.zh: 摆在我们面前的这项决议，代表了我们调查腐败、妨碍司法和滥用权力行为不可或缺的下一步。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the House Judiciary Committee voted to move ahead with a possible impeachment of President Trump by approving a set of rules for investigating his conduct.
sentences.zh: 周四，众议院司法委员会通过了一套调查总统特朗普行为的规则，从而投票决定推进可能对其实施的弹劾。

sentences.en: That investigation could be a precursor to impeachment down the line.
sentences.zh: 这项调查可能是未来弹劾的前奏。

sentences.en: Some call this process an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 有人将这个过程称为弹劾质询。

sentences.en: Some call it an impeachment investigation.
sentences.zh: 有人称之为弹劾调查。

sentences.en: There's no legal difference between these terms and I no longer care to argue about the nomenclature.
sentences.zh: 这些术语在法律上没有区别，我也懒得再去争论这些称呼了。

sentences.en: Thursday's vote was cast along party lines with Democrats supporting it and Republicans opposing it, calling it a backdoor to impeachment.
sentences.zh: 周四的投票结果完全按党派划线，民主党人支持，共和党人则表示反对，称这是弹劾的后门。

sentences.en: Now comes this resolution that's supposed to be setting up a basis for impeachment or as we'd say in Texas, this is fixing to be an impeachment.
sentences.zh: 现在这份决议本该为弹劾奠定基础，或者用我们在得克萨斯州的话说，这就是要开始弹劾了。

sentences.en: It isn't now but maybe it's fixing to be.
sentences.zh: 现在还不是，但也许快要是了。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration said it had repealed regulation that gave the federal government sweeping authority to protect rivers, lakes, streams, and wetlands from pollution.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府表示，已废除了一项赋予联邦政府广泛权力的法规，以保护河流、湖泊、溪流和湿地免受污染。

sentences.en: As a result, polluters will no longer need a permit to discharge potentially harmful substances into those bodies of water.
sentences.zh: 因此，污染者将不再需要许可证即可向这些水体排放潜在的有害物质。

sentences.en: The regulation created by
sentences.zh: 这项由

sentences.en: President Obama had upset companies, farmers, and homeowners, particularly in rural regions, who said it was overly broad and allowed the government to regulate their private
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统制定的法规惹恼了企业、农民和房主，特别是农村地区的人，他们认为该法规范围过于广泛，允许政府监管他们的私人

sentences.zh: 财产。
